environment.consideration: Environmental designations, protected habitats or seasonal controls may apply.

highway.consideration: Highway permission, notices or traffic-management requirements may apply.

trees.consideration: Tree, hedge, root or ecology controls may apply.

copy.R003: Posts, augers, drivers or excavators can puncture a buried cable or pipe. Confirm the service position before penetrating the ground.
copy.R005: Private gas, electricity, water, drainage or telecom services may be shallow and may not appear on asset-owner plans.
copy.R015: Utility plans are indicative and may not show the precise position or depth of an asset.
copy.MT004: Use competent detection appropriate to the site and ground conditions before intrusive work.
copy.MT005: Carefully expose or otherwise verify critical assets before mechanical excavation or driving posts.
